# A queue outside the tool cupboard

There were enough drills for everyone but only Jo could unlock the cupboard. Buying another drill would not have changed the queue. Tried a sign-out tray beside the bench and let Rafi supervise it. The queue shortened without anyone working faster. [[Volunteer handbook]] should describe who can authorize access, not merely list the things available.
